wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the decision is over a URL value that is written into an attribute; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource an authority check could pick instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: every rendered attribute is the same direction (content to output); there is no role or peer split
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protection is on rendered output, not on a read or write verb; the compiler and renderer have no verb split
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the value is decoded before the scheme decision because the browser decodes it too; there is no later clamp, offset or normalisation that turns a checked value into a different unsafe one
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the decision uses only the value and a fixed refuse-list; no authority or secret lookup can fail open
